summary: Iteration 6 — Pôle 2 bug-fix validation (Ouvrir une séance CTA, delete/share per-event buttons, + Nouveau on portal, TEST_ cleanup, DELETE cascade+RBAC). Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_iter6_delete_cascade.py with 10 focused tests — 10/10 PASS in 4.2s. Verified (a) DELETE /api/evenements/{eid} → 403 for ouvrier, 403 for evangeliste, 204 for pasteur; missing event → 404; (b) cascade correctly removes participants, active session, pointages, enfants (dashboard after delete shows total=0/pointages=0/enfants=0); (c) POST /api/evenements works for pasteur AND ouvrier (evang → 403); (d) startup TEST_ cleanup effective — GET /api/evenements returns exactly the 4 seeded events (Sortie d'évangélisation, Veillée de prière, Culte spécial - Anciens, Réunion des jeunes) with NO TEST_ prefixed entries. Frontend Playwright mobile 390x844: verified for admin@udamg.app (pasteur), ouvrier@udamg.app, evangeliste@udamg.app all 3 roles. testID 'evenements-create' (+ Nouveau pill) visible for pasteur & ouvrier, HIDDEN for evangeliste ✓. Per-card buttons: 'evt-share-{id}' present for ALL roles (4/4 events for each user), 'evt-delete-{id}' present ONLY for pasteur (4/4 for pasteur, 0/4 for ouvrier & evang) ✓. Share button: tapping copies /inscription?event={id}&titre=... to clipboard, toast 'Lien copié ✓' shown ✓. GREEN 'Ouvrir une séance' CTA (testID 'hub-open-session', background rgb(16,185,129)=colors.success) correctly renders on Hub screen ONLY when no active session AND user is pastoral — verified on 'Veillée de prière' event (no active session) as pasteur. Tapping the CTA navigates to /event/{id}/pasteur?openStart=1 (URL param confirmed) AND the 'Lancer une séance' modal auto-opens on the Pasteur screen (testID 'start-session-input' FOUND immediately) ✓. Regression sanity: 'Sortie d'évangélisation - Centre-ville' event (which has an active 'Séance 1' left over from prior iterations) correctly HIDES the hub-open-session CTA — confirms conditional logic works both ways. HOWEVER, one CRITICAL blocker found for web preview: the delete confirmation (Alert.alert with Annuler/Supprimer buttons in evenements/index.tsx:93-102) does NOT trigger any dialog on React Native Web — RN-Web's Alert.alert only calls window.alert(title) and IGNORES the buttons array, so the destructive onPress={deleteMut.mutate} is NEVER invoked in the web preview. Tapping 'Supprimer' does nothing (0 dialogs captured, card not removed, no DELETE request fired). This will still work correctly on native (Expo Go / iOS / Android builds), but is broken on the web preview the user is testing with.

ui_bugs.issue: Alert.alert with buttons does NOT show a dialog on React Native Web — RN-Web polyfills it to window.alert(title) and silently drops the button callbacks, so the delete flow is BROKEN on web preview (works on native only). Tap on 🗑 Supprimer produces no dialog, no DELETE request, no state change. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(app)/evenements/index.tsx:93-102.

integration_issues.issue: Alert.alert buttons ignored by react-native-web. Recommend: on web use window.confirm() fallback or a custom cross-platform Modal. Example fix: `if (Platform.OS==='web') { if (window.confirm('Supprimer ?')) deleteMut.mutate(evt.id); } else { Alert.alert(...) }` or replace with existing Modal pattern already used in create form.

action_items: HIGH: Replace Alert.alert-based delete confirmation in /app/frontend/app/(app)/evenements/index.tsx (confirmDelete function) with a cross-platform solution. Suggested fix: `if (Platform.OS === 'web') { if (window.confirm(`Supprimer « ${evt.titre} » ? Cette action est définitive.`)) deleteMut.mutate(evt.id); } else { Alert.alert(...) }`. Otherwise users cannot delete events from the web preview (the exact env they've been testing in).
(Optional) Consider replacing Alert.alert entirely with a custom RN Modal for delete confirm to have consistent styling and testability across platforms.

rca_of_issue: RCA for delete-on-web failure: react-native-web's Alert module (versions < 0.20 and even current) is a polyfill that maps Alert.alert(title, message, buttons?) to a plain window.alert(title) call — it does not implement the buttons UI nor invoke button.onPress callbacks. This is documented behavior: https://necolas.github.io/react-native-web/docs/alert/. Since UDAMG frontend uses `Alert.alert('Supprimer...', ..., [{text:'Annuler'}, {text:'Supprimer', onPress: () => deleteMut.mutate(evt.id)}])`, the destructive onPress is dead code on web. Mitigation: use Platform.OS-conditional logic (window.confirm on web) OR a custom RN Modal that renders identical UI on web+native (the codebase already uses Modal for the create form — same pattern can be reused for a ConfirmDialog component).
